descriptionByLocale.en:
More than 1,000 employees at 30 locations in Switzerland and Europe: the CSD Group is a dynamic and growing company. Thanks to the ingenuity, skill and multidisciplinarity that characterize our teams, CSD offers innovative and sustainable solutions for our customers with a "plus" for quality of life and the environment. We're looking for our branch Environment in Grand-Lancy (GE) an engineer wishing to be part of a development path towards project management. We offer you - Projects with high technical and territorial value - Participation in flagship projects in the canton of Geneva: infrastructure, sustainable urban development - Environmental missions at the heart of high-impact territorial decisions - Regular field trips: site visits and follow-up of in situ projects - A clear path to the position of Project Leader - Gradually taking responsibility for your own mandates - Internal training targeted by our CSD Academy and immersion learning - Leadership by experienced project managers, with regular feedback - A responsible and flexible framework - Multidisciplinary team of about 20 people in Geneva - Short decision circuits, proximity to the direction - Flexibility of working time (80–100%, telework possible) - Strong resources to work effectively - Support from internal experts (hydraulic, geotechnical, biodiversity, civil engineering) - GIS support, DAO and integrated field teams - Structured and proven project management tools
• Your responsibilities - Environmental studies and project management - Intervention on structural territorial projects, at the interface between city and countryside: environmental diagnostics, planning and high-risk development projects - Contribution to the entire project value chain: - Strategic upstream phases: Strategic environmental studies (SEEs), support for cantonal/municipal public decisions - Project and Operational Phases: Impact Assessments, Expertises, Environmental Monitoring Pilot - Multidisciplinary approach integrating all environmental themes: water, soil, noise, air, climate, biodiversity, etc., with a comprehensive and coherent vision of the issues - High value-added deliverables: reports, space analysis (SIG) and decision support - Environmental monitoring of concrete infrastructure projects: soft mobility (green roads, cycle paths), renaturalisation, urban developments linked to water and nature in cities, conversion of sites (graviers, etc.) - Water management (by profile) - Contribution to integrated urban water management projects, including the dimensioning of source solutions (infiltration, retention) at the interface between hydraulics, soils and urban development - Support for studies in sanitation, storm and wastewater management, river development - Participation in water-related natural hazard analyses (floods, surface runoff), including hazard mapping, territorial diagnostics and planning decision-making guidance - Collaboration with hydraulic modelling specialists in interpreting results and translating them into operational recommendations
• Your profile - EPF / HES training in environmental science and engineering, civil engineering or equivalent, with minimum 2 to 3 years of experience having enabled you to acquire good technical bases and a first exposure to concrete projects - Good understanding of the Swiss environmental regulatory framework and ease with GIS tools (QGIS, ArcGIS), which you use independently in your analyses - Ability to structure your thinking and produce clear, rigorous and useful deliverables for decision making - Independent and reliable profile, able to proactively advance while integrating into a multidisciplinary team - Strong interest in cross-cutting approaches and willingness to move towards a project leader/fe role Offers of employment agencies are not taken into account in this recruitment. Consequently, CSD will not enter into any negotiation for the payment of any claim.

Nous recherchons pour notre succursale Environnement à Grand-Lancy (GE) un/e ingénieur/e souhaitant s'inscrire dans une trajectoire de développement vers la gestion de projets.

  • Des projets à forte valeur technique et territoriale

    • Participation à des projets phares du canton de Genève : infrastructures, développement durable de l’agglomération

    • Missions environnementales au cœur de décisions territoriales à fort impact

    • Sorties terrain régulières : visites de chantiers et suivi de réalisations in situ

  • Une trajectoire claire vers le poste de Chef de Projet

    • Prise de responsabilités progressive sur vos propres mandats

    • Formation interne ciblée par notre CSD Academy et apprentissage par immersion

    • Encadrement par des chefs de projet expérimentés, avec feedback régulier

    • Circuits courts de décision, proximité avec la direction

    • Appui d’experts internes (hydraulique, géotechnique, biodiversité, génie civil)

    • Support SIG, DAO et équipes terrain intégrés

    • Participation à des analyses de risques naturels liés à l’eau (inondations, ruissellement de surface), incluant l’exploitation de cartes de dangers, les diagnostics territoriaux et l’orientation des décisions d’aménagement

    • Collaboration avec des spécialistes en modélisation hydraulique pour l’interprétation des résultats et leur traduction en recommandations opérationnelles

  • Formation EPF / HES en sciences et ingénierie de l’environnement, génie civil ou équivalent, avec minimum 2 à 3 ans d’expérience vous ayant permis d’acquérir de bonnes bases techniques et une première exposition à des projets concrets

  • Bonne compréhension du cadre réglementaire suisse en matière d’environnement et aisance avec les outils SIG (QGIS, ArcGIS), que vous utilisez de manière autonome dans vos analyses

  • Capacité à structurer votre pensée et à produire des livrables clairs, rigoureux et utiles à la prise de décision

  • Profil autonome et fiable, capable d’avancer de manière proactive tout en s’intégrant dans une équipe pluridisciplinaire

  • Intérêt marqué pour les approches transversales et volonté de progresser vers un rôle de chef/fe de projet
